items.front: In AWS Organizations, management account or member account: which one do SCPs restrict?
items.extra: SCPs [affect only member accounts](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-scp-no-effect-on-management-account), not the [users or roles in the management account](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-scp-no-effect-on-management-account).

items.front: In AWS Organizations, can a member account administrator with AdministratorAccess use an action that an SCP above the account denies?
items.back: No. The SCP still blocks the action.
items.extra: Users and roles [can't use that permission](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-scp-admin-policy-cannot-override), even when the administrator [attaches the AdministratorAccess IAM policy](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-scp-admin-policy-cannot-override).

items.front: In AWS Control Tower, preventive control or detective control: which one stops the noncompliant action?
items.extra: [Preventive controls prevent actions from occurring](../facts/control-tower.md#control-tower-preventive-detective-proactive-defined); a detective control [provides alerts through the dashboard](../facts/control-tower.md#control-tower-detective-alerts-dashboard-status).

items.front: In AWS Organizations, teams in several member accounts must launch instances into the subnets of one central VPC. What do you use?
items.back: Share the subnets with AWS RAM.
items.extra: AWS RAM shares a subnet with [only AWS accounts in its own organization](../facts/ram.md#ram-share-subnets-only-within-organization), and it [eliminates the need to provision duplicate resources](../facts/ram.md#ram-reduces-overhead-no-duplicate-resources).

items.front: In AWS Organizations, can you make another account the management account of an existing organization?
items.back: No. The management account stays the same account.

items.front: In AWS Organizations, SCP or RCP: which one can limit principals outside the organization?
items.extra: RCPs can affect [principals external to your organization](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-rcp-affects-external-principals-scp-only-internal); SCPs reach only [principals within your AWS organization](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-rcp-affects-external-principals-scp-only-internal).

items.front: In AWS Control Tower, do the controls bind an existing account that you never enrolled and whose OU you never registered?
items.back: No. Register the OU or enroll the account first.
items.extra: Accounts and OUs created outside Control Tower stay outside its controls until you [separately register the OU or enroll the account](../facts/control-tower.md#control-tower-accounts-outside-not-bound).

items.front: In AWS Organizations, many accounts need one bill and shared Reserved Instance discounts. What do you use?
items.extra: Consolidated billing [shares the volume pricing discounts, Reserved Instance discounts](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-consolidated-billing-combined-usage-shares-discounts) and is [offered at no additional cost](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-consolidated-billing-combined-usage-shares-discounts).

items.front: In AWS Organizations, the OUs under the root can be nested at most {{c1::five levels of OUs deep}}.
In AWS Organizations, you can attach at most {{c1::10}} SCPs directly to one root, OU or account.
items.extra: Inherited SCPs do not count, and [All policy limits are hard limits](../facts/organizations.md#organizations-attachment-limits-direct-only-hard). This limit changed in 2026: older practice questions can show a lower number.

items.front: In AWS Organizations, an invitation to join an organization expires after {{c1::15 days}}.
In AWS Organizations, you can reopen a closed AWS account within {{c1::90 days}}.
